messages:
Ruth: Quick check-in — final sweep on the launch blog (hero + 3 bullets + CTA) before we lock tomorrow? Need bench wording and webinar CTA mapping.
Carlos: I can do hero + social headline. Will push copy in ~15.
Mei: I'll author the benchmark blurb and include brief test context. Plan to call out median and p95.
Ethan: Webinar capacity: 1pm and 4pm slots available. Recommend pinning 4pm for EMEA-friendly timing.
Gabe: HubSpot mapping ready, but need utm_campaign and the field name for demo_slot. Suggest utm_campaign=beta_launch_q2 and field demo_pref.
Nora (Legal): Quick note: avoid absolutes. "Up to" for comparisons; add "internal benchmarks" qualifier. I can sign off by 3pm today.
Carlos: Posted hero v3 (short) + alt headline for socials. Link: https://docs.google.com/xxx
Mei: Bench numbers drafted: "median latency up to 2.5x faster, p95 up to 1.8x in our internal benchmarks (tests run on A100-equivalent; avg seq ~128)." Keeping "up to" and "internal" per legal rec.
Gabe: HubSpot hidden fields snippet pasted in doc. Routing rule: utm_campaign=beta_launch_q2 -> assign to queue "beta-inbound"; company_size>200 -> enterprise funnel.
Ethan: Pinned 16:00 demo, updated calendar name to "Beta Launch Demo (Redwood)". Test registration flows ok.
Ruth: OK locking CTAs: primary "Register for launch demo"; secondary "Request dedicated eval (subject to qualification)". If no objections by 3pm Ill schedule publish for tomorrow 9am PT. :rocket:
Nora (Legal): Sign-off provided in doc comments for current language.
Ruth: Thanks team — final publish window set for tomorrow 9am PT.
